self_assessment: All 9 Requirements bullets covered: MAX_LENGTHS_API.CALENDAR_URL=10000 replaces the file-local CALENDAR_URL_MAX_LENGTH; isURLTooLong (length > limit) feeds a single `disabled` flag (empty || invalid format || too long) used in BOTH the error and normal submitProps -- note the two sites differ in indentation, so a replace_all with one indent silently patched only the error branch and my throwaway test caught it; getWarning() returns exactly one message in the stated priority (extension -> Google-public -> too long -> null) and is passed straight to InputFieldTwo's warning, with hint/counter and maxLength removed; ResizeObserver mocked once in packages/components, applications/calendar and applications/mail jest.setup.js with all 4 inline redefinitions removed (2 calendar specs, mail's mockDomApi, useSendVerifications.test.ts). Verified: throwaway 16-case spec 16/16 green; control A (revert modal+constant, keep the setup mock) flips exactly the 5 new-behaviour cases red and leaves the 11 pre-existing ones green; control B (revert only packages/components/jest.setup.js) flips 15/16 -- every render throws `ReferenceError: ResizeObserver is not defined` from Scroll.tsx, which proves the base packages/components suite CANNOT render this modal without the global mock, i.e. the setup change is required by any hidden test for it. Real suites green after the change: calendar CalendarSidebar+MainContainer 15/15, mail useSendVerifications 12/12, mail components/message 187/187. Gates all exit 0: tsc --noEmit for packages/components + applications/calendar + applications/mail, eslint and prettier --check on the 9 touched files (3 eslint warnings, all on pre-existing lines). Patch re-applies to a stashed base (git apply --check exit 0). Two judgement calls declared: (1) 'For useGetCalendarSetup use a proper default export structure' was ALREADY satisfied at base -- it is `export default` and imported directly from its module (not via the hooks barrel), and I proved a jest.mock of it intercepts cleanly without executing the real hook, so no edit was made; (2) 'no code or module reassigns ResizeObserver outside the global setup' -- I left packages/polyfill/index.js's guarded `if (!window.ResizeObserver) install()` alone: it is the production browser polyfill (never loaded by jest, and guarded so it never overwrites), while the title and problem statement scope this bullet to test setup. Also declared: isURLValid stays format-only rather than folding length in, because InputField renders error INSTEAD of warning, so making a long URL 'invalid' would surface 'Invalid URL' and suppress the required 'URL is too long' warning; the limit is exclusive (> not >=) per 'longer than this value'.
